page_account: The opening continuation says that p double-prime is now literally an inclusion but morally still a fibration, with a bracketed description of its fibres and a comparison with the Cartan–Serre fibration slogan.
It proposes that the last diagram could be constructed directly in an algebraic setting after an étale tubular-neighbourhood construction has been developed.

The next paragraph relates constructible sheaves, complexes and n-champs for an equisingular stratification to a diagram of homotopy types or pro-types. A triangular source maps right to X_1 and down to X_0.
Local systems on X_0 and X_1 are linked by a compatibility map between their pullbacks to the common source. The author introduces an unperformed exercise, but the page stops at de.

check_events.method: Read p: Delta→X_0 and J: Delta→X_1 directly from the arrowheads. Given F_0 on X_0 and F_1 on X_1, p*(F_0) and J*(F_1) both lie over Delta; hence a morphism from the former to the latter is well-typed. The cancelled third vertex in the list of independently chosen systems is compatible with this distinction. This is a local typing calculation, not proof of equivalence of categories.
